title: Dominic and the Passage
author: Edmund Kavanagh
blurb: Felix Yarrow, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
